'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Michael Dalton LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Dalton]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
